notes.title: MILLION ARTHUR: ARCANA BLOOD 29th August Patch Notes
notes.content:
1 We've optimised both the downloading of a section of the data and the background rendering.

2. We've fixed the issue in which the function to increase defensive power when HP is reduced does not work. *This only occurred in battles online.

3. We've fixed the bug in which a section of keys were not supported in the keyboard settings.

4. We've fixed some parts of the text in a section of the titles.

5. In NETWORK mode, "PLAYER MATCH>ROOM SEARCH", we have changed the spec and  players can now choose to enter the grayed out rooms. 
* Whether or not the player can actually get in the room will be depended on the connection status between the player and the host.

notes.title: Million Arthur: Arcana Blood Patch 1.22 Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we'd like to apologise for the networking error which you've been experiencing while trying to play. 

We've just uploaded patch version 1.22 to solve this problem.

Sorry for any inconvenience caused, and thank you very much for your patience whilst we've worked to correct this problem.

The Million Arthur: Arcana Blood team

notes.title: Million Arthur: Arcana Blood out now!
notes.content:
Set in a fictional version of Britain, home to a million King Arthurs, and a million Excaliburs, Million Arthur: Arcana Blood is a fast and fluid fighting game featuring 13 playable characters including special guest fighters: ’Otherworldly Riesz’ from TRIALS OF MANA,  ’Otherworldly Koume Sakiyama’ from LORD of VERMILION IV and ‘Otherworldly Iori Yagami’ from “THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV”. Using the power of the knights and the faeries of antiquity, the Arthurs battle to unite a country that is rocked by regular civil wars and dangerous outside threats.

https://youtu.be/WzwbT6s0t7U

To celebrate the launch, the Million Arthur: Arcana Blood LIMITED EDITION is now available until August 20, 2019 and includes:

•	Two striking wallpapers, featuring beautiful character art from the game (sizes: 1024 x 768, 1280 x 1024, 1920 x 1080, 2560 x 1600, 3840x2160)

•	A music sampler, with 5 of the punchiest tracks from the Yoko Shimomura-produced soundtrack

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Million Arthur: Arcana Blood
notes.content:
Million Arthur: Arcana Blood is Now Available on Steam! And for a limited time, receive a free mini soundtrack and bonus wallpapers when you purchase!

For the first time on Steam, the incredible, over-the-top 2D fighter Million Arthur: Arcana Blood is ready to kick-off, featuring many of the popular characters from the smash hit Million Arthur series as well as a variety of guest fighters!

notes.title: Punch through magical Britain in Square Enix s Million Arthur: Arcana Blood
notes.content:
Britain, Square Enix tell me, is “home to a million King Arthurs and a million Excaliburs.” Which checks out.

“The Arthurs each strive to become the one true king, wielding the power of the knights and the faeries of antiquity,” they continue. Sounds about right

Then they say these Arthurs “fight to unite a Britain where civil wars are a common occurrence” and ah c’mon Squeenix, now you’re rubbing salt into the wound. Give us a little fantasy to escape our Brithell. If your upcoming 2D fighting game Million Arthur: Arcana Blood is just my everyday reality I think I shall pass, thank you very much.

(more…)
